channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Unreleased footage reveals Lindsey Graham’s push for war on Iran
item.description: Unreleased documentary footage shows late US Senator Lindsey Graham celebrating the war on Iran.

item.title: Pakistan-administered Kashmir opens polls in violence-wracked vote
item.description: First of three rounds of voting held after weeks of protests during which dozens of people were killed.

item.title: Are the US and Iran heading towards a forever war?
item.description: Marc Lamont Hill speaks with sociologist Ali Kadivar on what history shows about the risk of a US forever war in Iran.

item.title: Saudi Arabia defends against drone strikes from ‘Iran-backed’ groups
item.description: Drones launched at Saudi, Jordan and Iraq suggest Iran, or linked groups, may be testing US as it mulls new strategy.

item.title: War on Iran: Phase II: Day 16
item.description: The US-Iran war has slowed, with both sides giving diplomacy a chance through regional mediators.

item.title: Iran: Currently no negotiations with the US
item.description: Iranian Foreign Ministry Spokesperson, Esmaeil Baghaei, said on Monday that Iran is not seeking negotiations with US.

item.title: Trump says Iran war talks taking place during lull in strikes
item.description: The US president says "there is a good chance that something could happen", as Iran denies direct talks are taking place.

item.title: Ukraine dismisses Iranian threats as Caspian Sea strike directly links wars
item.description: Iran has reacted with fury to the assault on the vessel, with Tehran's foreign minister saying it "cannot go unanswered".

item.title: Police still searching for second suspect in fatal Seattle food festival shooting
item.description: One suspect, a teenager, is in custody following the shooting, in which three people were killed and others injured.

item.title: More than 600 US military service members injured since Iran War began in February
item.description: The latest figure includes casualties from Operation Fury and a new category called "Overseas Operations".
